text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes all 16 tests. I didn't touch the tests. These are the fixes, all in `catalog/`:

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an int.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3, but the policy comment and the tests say five. It is now 5.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` added the daily rate to the number of days. It now multiplies them.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned one event too many because of an off-by-one in the slice. It now returns exactly `n`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` was missing the third book, so I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The author, year and copy count are my choice, since the tests only check the title.
